about: The evangelium of the formulary “Saint Anne, Mother of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, Jesus addressed His disciples with this parable: The kingdom of heaven is like a treasure hidden in a field; when a man found it, he hid it, and for joy over it he goes off and sells everything he has and buys that field. Once more, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant seeking good pearls. And having found one precious pearl, he went away and sold all that he had, and bought it. Once more, the kingdom of heaven is like a dragnet cast into the sea and gathering in fish of every sort. When it was full, they drew it out, and sitting by the shore, they picked out the good ones into vessels, but threw the bad ones out. So it will be at the consummation of the world: the angels will come forth and will separate the wicked from the midst of the just, and will throw them into the furnace of fire; there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth. Have you understood all this? They say to Him: Yes. He said to them: Therefore every scribe who is learned in the kingdom of heaven resembles a householder who brings out of his treasure things new and old.
